title: stc session cursor events, v2
description: events-1 plus the cursor-shape event (STC-239). t is session-relative integer nanoseconds (CGEvent.timestamp minus anchors.t0Ns; CGEvent.timestamp is already ns, never converted). x/y are global display-space points; subtract anchors.display.originX/Y for display-local coordinates. A cursor event says which macOS pointer is showing from t until the next cursor event; before the first one the arrow is showing. The shape is a name into the compositor's own artwork set, never a bitmap — compact, and render() stays a pure function of session data.

shape.description: exactly the set transform/src/cursor-art.ts can draw; cursor-art.test.ts keeps the two equal
